title: Bilinear controllability for the linear KdV-Schr{ö}dinger equation
summary: We study the controllability of a linear KdV-Schr{ö}dinger equation on the one-dimensional torus via purely imaginary bilinear controls. Considering controls spanning a suitable finite number of Fourier modes, we prove small-time global approximate controllability in L2(T). The result holds between any pair of states with the same norm and is obtained via the saturation method by following the idea introduced in [Poz24].
